prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: high-resolution photographic key visual for an immersive digital material sculpture. A single full-bleed 16:9 landscape image, ideally 2560 by 1440 or higher, absolutely no text, labels, typography, border or UI.
Primary request: directly overhead intimate geological macro photography of freshly cooling basaltic lava SKIN. A broad almost flat expanse of heavy black lava crust fills the entire image, cropped at all edges. A distinct cooling front travels diagonally from upper-left toward lower-right. Upper-left is older deeply black, dense, cooled surface with real fine pores; lower-right is newly blackened stretched thin skin with subtle broad rounded wrinkles. The entire image is dark, quiet and physically tactile.
Composition: clear restrained graphic order. Just four or five large curving plates of skin separated by narrow, uneven, red-orange seams, oriented mainly along one diagonal cooling boundary; avoid a spiderweb and avoid dry cracked earth. The plates feel pliable and slightly folded, not angular paving stones. Tiny pores and subtle nested wrinkles in the foreground, a little glassy reflection on black ridges. Leave a generous broad dark region in the upper-left with restrained surface detail, suitable for readable later overlay.
Light and palette: 85 percent volcanic black, obsidian black and graphite, at most a few percent restrained hot seams. Fine black details should be legible in very soft cool neutral raking illumination. Interior heat exposes only thin ember red lips between thick black crust plates; small near-white core at one short point where newest skin separates. Heat lights only millimeters of adjacent crust. Photorealistic large format macro photography, rich real mineral texture, dense tonal blacks without crushing to featureless flat black, dramatic but calm.
Constraints: no volcanic landscape, no flames, no smoke, no particles, no molten river, no orange ocean, no disaster imagery, no polygons, no crystalline blue, no neon web, no fantasy or gaming lava shader look, no CGI plastic. This image shows believable formation of cooling skin with a clear surface progression, not a collection of broken dry rocks.
